zh.headline: Anthropic 被美国政府勒令下线 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5
zh.observation: 今天最重磅的事件无疑是 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 被美国政府强制下线，这标志着 AI 安全与地缘政治的矛盾进入了一个前所未有的阶段。此前行业内的安全讨论多停留在理论或自愿层面，而此次政府直接动用出口管制手段，意味着前沿 AI 模型已成为国家战略资产，其部署、访问和供应链将受到严格管控。对于 AI Builder 而言，这意味着需要重新评估模型依赖风险，并将合规与安全作为产品的核心设计要素，而非事后修补。同时，亚马逊 CEO 的深度介入也揭示了科技巨头在政府决策中的微妙角色，未来的 AI 生态将更加复杂化。

items.title: Anthropic 被美国政府勒令下线 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5
items.desc: 美国政府出于国家安全担忧，命令 Anthropic 切断 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 对所有海外用户（包括其员工）的访问，Anthropic 已完全关闭模型访问。
items.value: AI 安全与地缘政治冲突的里程碑事件，影响全球模型部署策略。

items.title: 亚马逊 CEO 被曝在政府行动前已提出对 Anthropic 模型的担忧
items.desc: 据 WSJ 报道，Andy Jassy 的网络安全研究及其与白宫的对话是促成政府对 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 实施出口管制的部分原因。
items.value: 揭示大厂与政府互动如何影响前沿 AI 部署，引发对供应链安全的关注。

items.title: 传闻中国可能已接触 Anthropic 的 Mythos 模型
items.desc: Semafor 报道称，白宫对 Mythos 实施出口限制的部分原因是担心该模型已被与中国有关联的团体访问。
items.value: AI 模型成为国家战略资产，模型安全与防泄露成为核心议题。

items.title: Meta 据报应北京要求，拟撤销 20 亿美元收购 Manus 的交易
items.desc: Meta 开始撤销其 20 亿美元对 Manus 的收购，此前北京要求该交易必须逆转。
items.value: 地缘政治直接影响 AI 领域跨国并购，凸显技术资产管控的严峻性。

items.title: OpenAI 面临多州总检察长调查
items.desc: 调查涉及 OpenAI 的广告政策、健康数据处理等多个方面，具体参与州尚未明确。
items.value: AI 巨头面临更广泛的监管审查，合规成本与风险显著上升。

items.title: 法院裁定 Google 须为 AI Overviews 生成的虚假陈述承担法律责任
items.desc: 判决认为设计、训练、运营 AI 系统的公司须对系统生成的回答造成的损害承担法律责任。
items.value: 确立 AI 产品责任判例，对 AI 产品发布和内容审核产生深远影响。

items.title: KPMG 因明显幻觉撤回 AI 使用报告
items.desc: 四大会计事务所之一 KPMG 因其发布的 AI 使用报告中存在明显幻觉而撤回报告。
items.value: 即使专业机构也难逃 AI 幻觉陷阱，警示 AI 生成内容的审查必要性。

items.title: 苹果 iOS 27 发布首批 AI 照片编辑工具
items.desc: 包括重新构图、扩展和清理等功能，效果相比 Pixel 等竞品较为保守，但覆盖用户基数巨大。
items.value: AI 照片编辑进入主流消费市场，苹果的保守策略与谷歌形成鲜明对比。

items.title: Meta 员工强烈反对扎克伯格的 AI 黑客马拉松计划
items.desc: 员工在公司内部论坛公开质疑，认为公司文化已不再支持黑客马拉松。
items.value: 反映大型科技公司内部创新文化与自上而下 AI 战略执行之间的张力。

items.title: IEEE 研究：视觉语言模型训练机器人读取人类情绪
items.desc: 研究人员通过视觉语言模型训练协作机器人，不仅识别面部表情，还理解情绪，以更好地与人协作。
items.value: 推动具身智能的情感交互能力，为人机协作场景提供新思路。

items.title: LLM 的冷启动安全缺口
items.desc: 研究发现工具调用型 LLM Agent 在对话开始时最脆弱，完成几个常规任务后安全性显著提升。
items.value: 揭示了 Agent 安全性的动态特性，对 Agent 部署的安全策略设计有重要指导意义。

items.title: 计算感知下的 LLM 对抗鲁棒性评估
items.desc: 提出攻击成功率应结合计算成本评估，不同攻击策略的计算开销差异可达数量级。
items.value: 为 LLM 安全评估提供了更务实的度量标准，避免被高计算成本的攻击所误导。

items.title: VIA-SD：模型内路由加速投机解码
items.desc: 提出用大模型内部的轻量子模型验证被主模型拒绝的 token，替代全量重算，提升推理效率。
items.value: 为 LLM 推理加速提供新思路，无需额外模型即可提升投机解码效率。

items.title: Flash-GMM：单 GPU 高效高斯混合模型核
items.desc: 通过融合 Triton 核消除全责任矩阵显存占用，实现 20 倍加速，支持比之前大 100 倍的数据集。
items.value: 极大降低了大规模 GMM 聚类的计算门槛，对向量检索、数据挖掘等领域有直接应用价值。

items.title: TreeSeeker：树结构深度搜索 Agent
items.desc: 提出一种推理时框架，通过树结构的试错与回溯，解决多步网页搜索中的探索与利用平衡问题。
items.value: 为构建可靠的深度搜索 Agent 提供了有效框架，提升了复杂问答任务的完成质量。

items.title: HYDRA-X：原生统一多模态模型
items.desc: 首个在单个 ViT 中统一图像和视频 Token 化的多模态模型，实现了更高效的视觉表示。
items.value: 简化了多模态模型的架构设计，为构建更通用的视觉理解模型铺平道路。

items.title: WebChallenger：可靠高效的通用 Web Agent
items.desc: 通过模拟人类的三种认知优势（选择性注意、持久记忆、程序流畅性），提升 LLM Agent 的网页导航能力。
items.value: 为开发低成本、高性能的网页 Agent 提供了架构设计范本。

items.title: TRACE：将用户更正编译为编码 Agent 的运行时约束
items.desc: 提出了一种即插即用的技能层，将用户偏好编译为运行时约束，显著提升了编码 Agent 对用户偏好的遵从度。
items.value: 解决了编码 Agent 的“记性差”问题，提升了交互效率和用户体验。

items.title: 异构 Agent 间的密集潜在通信
items.desc: 提出在异构 Agent 间通过 KV-cache 进行潜在空间通信，避免了文本通信的解码-再编码损失。
items.value: 为构建高效的异构多 Agent 协作系统提供了理论基础和技术路径。

items.title: LLM 注释任务适应性的极限
items.desc: 研究了模型内部先验知识如何影响零样本注释任务的性能，以及提示中额外信息的纠错能力。
items.value: 对 LLM-as-a-Judge 和自动化数据标注的可靠性提出了关键见解。

items.title: Agent-Reach
items.desc: 一个 CLI 工具，让 AI Agent 无需 API 费用即可读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站、小红书等全平台内容。
items.value: 为 Agent 提供零成本、跨平台的互联网感知能力，极大扩展 Agent 数据获取边界。

items.title: hyperframes
items.desc: 一个由 HeyGen 开发的工具，让你用 HTML 编写脚本，渲染成视频。为 AI Agent 构建视频生成能力。
items.value: 为 Agent 提供程序化视频生成能力，将 HTML 技能直接转化为视频创作。

items.title: agentsview
items.desc: 本地优先的编码 Agent 会话智能与分析平台，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 20+ Agent，速度比 cusage 快 100 倍。
items.value: 为使用编码 Agent 的开发者提供了强大的会话分析、调试和优化工具。

items.title: codegraph
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等编码 Agent 提供预索引的代码知识图谱，减少 token 消耗和工具调用，完全本地运行。
items.value: 通过知识图谱增强编码 Agent 的代码理解能力，降低使用成本。

items.title: archify
items.desc: 任何 Agent 均可使用的技能，用于生成支持深色/浅色主题切换的、可导出为 PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG 格式的漂亮架构图。
items.value: 为 Agent 提供了生成专业架构图的能力，提升文档和演示质量。

items.title: headroom
items.desc: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 块到达 LLM 之前进行压缩，可减少 60-95% 的 Token 消耗，同时保持答案质量。提供库、代理和 MCP 服务器。
items.value: 显著降低 LLM 使用成本，尤其适用于长上下文和 RAG 场景。

items.title: last30days-skill
items.desc: AI Agent 技能，可跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 和网络研究任何主题，并综合生成有依据的摘要。
items.value: 为 Agent 提供跨平台、多源的信息综合研究能力，是强大的信息收集工具。

items.title: taste-skill
items.desc: 一个“高能动性前端”技能，防止 AI 生成无聊、通用、低质量的内容，赋予 AI 良好的审美品味。
items.value: 解决 AI 生成内容同质化问题，提升输出质量和独特性。

items.title: Understand-Anything
items.desc: 将任何代码转化为可交互的知识图谱，支持探索、搜索和提问。可与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等集成。
items.value: 将静态代码转化为动态知识网络，极大提升代码理解和调试效率。

items.title: Kami
items.desc: 一个 AI 驱动的新闻阅读器，将优质内容转化为更好的阅读体验。
items.value: 为信息过载时代提供 AI 辅助的精选阅读方案。

en.headline: Anthropic Forced to Take Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Offline by US Government
en.observation: The most impactful event today is undoubtedly the US government forcing Anthropic to take Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline, marking an unprecedented escalation in the conflict between AI safety and geopolitics. Previous safety discussions were mostly theoretical or voluntary, but this direct use of export controls means frontier AI models are now strategic national assets, subject to strict control over deployment, access, and supply chains. For AI builders, this means reassessing model dependency risks and making compliance and safety core product design elements, not afterthoughts. Furthermore, the deep involvement of Amazon's CEO reveals the subtle role of tech giants in government decisions, pointing to an increasingly complex future AI ecosystem.

items.title: Anthropic Forced to Take Fable 5 and Mythos 5 Offline by US Government
items.desc: Due to national security concerns, the US government ordered Anthropic to block access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all foreign nations and employees, leading to a complete shutdown of the models.
items.value: A milestone event for AI safety and geopolitics, impacting global model deployment strategies.

items.title: Amazon CEO Reportedly Raised Anthropic Model Concerns Before Government Crackdown
items.desc: According to WSJ, Andy Jassy's cybersecurity research and conversations with the White House partially triggered the export controls on Fable 5 and Mythos 5.
items.value: Reveals how big tech and government interactions shape frontier AI deployment, raising supply chain security concerns.

items.title: China May Have Accessed Anthropic's Mythos Model
items.desc: A Semafor report suggests the White House's export restrictions on Mythos were partly driven by fears it had been accessed by a group linked to China.
items.value: AI models become strategic national assets; model security and leak prevention are now core issues.

items.title: Meta Reportedly Moves to Unwind $2B Manus Deal After Beijing's Demand
items.desc: Meta has started dismantling its $2 billion acquisition of Manus after Beijing ordered the deal reversed.
items.value: Geopolitics directly impacts cross-border AI M&A, highlighting the severity of tech asset control.

items.title: OpenAI Faces Investigation from State Attorneys General
items.desc: The investigation covers OpenAI's ad policies and health data handling; the specific states involved are not yet clear.
items.value: AI giants face broader regulatory scrutiny, significantly increasing compliance costs and risks.

items.title: Court Rules Google Liable for False Statements Generated by AI Overviews
items.desc: The ruling holds that a company designing, training, and operating an AI system is legally liable for damages caused by its responses.
items.value: Establishes a precedent for AI product liability, with far-reaching implications for AI product release and content moderation.

items.title: KPMG Pulls Report on AI Usage Due to Apparent Hallucinations
items.desc: One of the Big Four accounting firms, KPMG, retracted its AI usage report after finding apparent hallucinations within it.
items.value: Even professional institutions are not immune to AI hallucinations, underscoring the need for content review.

items.title: Apple's iOS 27 Launches First AI Photo Editing Tools
items.desc: Features include reframing, extending, and clean-up. More conservative than competitors like Pixel, but with a massive user base.
items.value: AI photo editing enters the mainstream consumer market; Apple's conservative approach contrasts sharply with Google's.

items.title: Meta Employees Strongly Oppose Zuckerberg's AI Hackathon Plan
items.desc: Employees publicly questioned the plan on internal forums, arguing the company culture no longer supports hackathons.
items.value: Reflects the tension between internal innovation culture and top-down AI strategy execution at big tech firms.

items.title: IEEE Study: Visual Language Models Train Robots to Read Human Emotions
items.desc: Researchers trained collaborative robots using VLMs to not only recognize facial expressions but also understand emotions for better human-robot collaboration.
items.value: Advances emotional interaction capabilities for embodied AI, offering new ideas for human-robot collaboration scenarios.

items.title: The Cold-Start Safety Gap in LLM Agents
items.desc: Research finds tool-calling LLM agents are most vulnerable at the start of a conversation and become significantly safer after completing a few regular agentic tasks.
items.value: Reveals the dynamic nature of agent safety, offering crucial guidance for safety strategy design in agent deployment.

items.title: Compute-Aware Evaluation of Adversarial Robustness in LLMs
items.desc: Proposes evaluating attack success rate in conjunction with computational cost, as the cost of different strategies can vary by orders of magnitude.
items.value: Provides a more pragmatic metric for LLM safety evaluation, avoiding misleading conclusions from high-cost attacks.

items.title: VIA-SD: Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
items.desc: Proposes using a slim sub-model from the verifier to handle rejected tokens instead of full recomputation, improving inference efficiency.
items.value: Offers a new approach to LLM inference acceleration without requiring additional models.

items.title: Flash-GMM: A Memory-Efficient Kernel for Scalable Soft Clustering
items.desc: A fused Triton kernel that eliminates full responsibility matrix memory usage, achieving 20x speedup and supporting 100x larger datasets.
items.value: Dramatically lowers the computational barrier for large-scale GMM clustering, with direct applications in vector search and data mining.

items.title: TreeSeeker: Tree-Structured Trial, Error, and Return in Deep Search
items.desc: An inference-time framework that balances exploration and exploitation in multi-step web search through tree-structured trial and error.
items.value: Provides an effective framework for building reliable deep search agents, improving complex QA task completion quality.

items.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models
items.desc: The first multimodal model to unify image and video tokenization within a single ViT, enabling more efficient visual representation.
items.value: Simplifies multimodal model architecture design, paving the way for more general-purpose visual understanding models.

items.title: WebChallenger: A Reliable and Efficient Generalist Web Agent
items.desc: Improves LLM agent web navigation by simulating three human cognitive advantages: selective attention, persistent memory, and procedural fluency.
items.value: Provides an architectural design template for developing low-cost, high-performance web agents.

items.title: TRACE: Compiling User Corrections into Runtime Enforcement for Coding Agents
items.desc: A drop-in skill layer that compiles user preferences into runtime constraints, significantly improving coding agent compliance with user preferences.
items.value: Solves the "poor memory" problem of coding agents, improving interaction efficiency and user experience.

items.title: Dense Latent Communication Across Heterogeneous Agents
items.desc: Proposes latent space communication via KV-cache between heterogeneous agents, avoiding the decode-re-encode loss of text communication.
items.value: Provides theoretical foundations and technical pathways for building efficient heterogeneous multi-agent collaboration systems.

items.title: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of Model-Internalized Priors on Annotation Task Performance
items.desc: Studies how model-internalized priors affect zero-shot annotation performance and the corrective power of additional prompt information.
items.value: Offers key insights into the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge and automated data annotation.

items.title: Agent-Reach
items.desc: A CLI tool giving AI agents eyes to read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and more, with zero API fees.
items.value: Provides zero-cost, cross-platform internet perception for agents, vastly expanding their data acquisition boundaries.

items.title: hyperframes
items.desc: A tool by HeyGen that lets you write HTML and render it as video, built for AI agents.
items.value: Enables programmatic video generation for agents, directly translating HTML skills into video creation.

items.title: agentsview
items.desc: A local-first session intelligence and analytics platform for coding agents, supporting Claude Code, Codex, and 20+ others, and is 100x faster than cusage.
items.value: Provides powerful session analysis, debugging, and optimization tools for developers using coding agents.

items.title: codegraph
items.desc: Pre-indexed code knowledge graphs for coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini, reducing token usage and tool calls, running 100% locally.
items.value: Enhances code understanding for coding agents via knowledge graphs, lowering usage costs.

items.title: archify
items.desc: A skill for any agent to generate beautiful architecture diagrams with dark/light theme toggle and export to PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG.
items.value: Empowers agents with the ability to generate professional architecture diagrams, improving documentation and presentation quality.

items.title: headroom
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM, reducing token usage by 60-95% while maintaining answer quality. Offers library, proxy, and MCP server.
items.value: Significantly reduces LLM usage costs, especially valuable for long-context and RAG scenarios.

items.title: last30days-skill
items.desc: An AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web, then synthesizes a grounded summary.
items.value: Provides cross-platform, multi-source information synthesis for agents, a powerful research tool.

items.title: taste-skill
items.desc: A "high-agency frontend" skill that prevents AI from generating boring, generic, low-quality content, giving AI good taste.
items.value: Addresses the homogeneity problem in AI-generated content, improving output quality and uniqueness.

items.title: Understand-Anything
items.desc: Turns any code into an interactive knowledge graph for exploration, search, and Q&A. Integrates with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more.
items.value: Transforms static code into dynamic knowledge networks, greatly improving code understanding and debugging efficiency.

items.title: Kami
items.desc: An AI-powered news reader that transforms good content into a better reading experience.
items.value: Offers an AI-assisted curated reading solution for the age of information overload.
